image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a black hockey puck resting on a dark, textured surface (likely ice or a mat). The top face features a prominent circular logo with the text 'SAINTS' in stylized blue and white lettering, accompanied by a fleur-de-lis symbol and a red diagonal stripe. The puck has a matte black rubber body with visible circumferential ridges along the side edge.

The geometry is consistent with a solid disk; no hollows or irregular shapes are visible.
The main body of the puck is black with a non-glossy, matte finish typical of vulcanized rubber.

artifact_observations.location: Top face logo, specifically the smaller text arcs above and below the central 'SAINTS' text.
artifact_observations.reasoning: While the main 'SAINTS' text is legible, the surrounding arc text is nonsensical and malformed, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than real branding copy. The letters merge and lack distinct kerning.

artifact_observations.location: Boundary between the printed logo and the black rubber surface.
artifact_observations.reasoning: The edges of the white and blue logo elements show slight bleeding and softness into the black rubber, lacking the crisp, raised ink edge typically seen on real pucks. It looks slightly 'painted on' rather than physically printed/embossed.
